identity.name: Old Cutler Bay
identity.hoa_name: OLD CUTLER BAY HOMEOWNERS CORPORATION, INC.
identity.notes: Old Cutler Bay is a voluntary, guard-gated single-family homeowners association (established 1986; community dates to the early 1960s) of approximately 136 luxury waterfront estate homes in Coral Gables, Miami-Dade County, FL, situated on ~150 acres of Biscayne Bay. 127 of 136 sites have direct, bridge-free deep-water canal access; security is provided 24/7 via a separate Security Guard Special Taxing District. The HOA is voluntary with no large shared amenities. HOA legal name: OLD CUTLER BAY HOMEOWNERS CORPORATION, INC. (Fed ID 592741020), office 360 Solano Prado, Miami, FL 33156; property manager FPMS, 5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota, FL, 941-960-5000.

fees.note: HOA fee is required (per florida-hoa.net listing), but the exact monthly/annual amount is not stated in available sources; the fee field is blank and public sources note specific fees are not disclosed. Property manager: FPMS (941-960-5000). Community size ~136 luxury homes, entry price ~$4.4M, peak valuation $47M (unverified marketing site).
Separate Old Cutler Bay Security Guard Special Taxing District collects assessments of approximately $4,900 for improved lots in recent data; exact period and current rate not specified.

amenities.detail: 24-hour guard-gated security with roving patrols, provided via a separate (city-administered) Security Guard Special Taxing District; entrance marked by Albert Aronson's 10-foot sculpture 'A World of Its Own' (dedicated 1965).
Direct, bridge-free deep-water canal access to Biscayne Bay (no vertical height restrictions); canals engineered through bedrock, deep water reachable in ~3 minutes.
127 of 136 estate sites have private seawalls and lot-line dockage; suitable for vessels drafting up to 5-6 feet (center consoles, deep-keel sailboats).
Private wet slips available via the Old Cutler Bay Marina Association.
No community-wide amenities such as clubhouses, pools, or recreational facilities are listed in HOA records; focus is on security and common-area maintenance.
